component.name: BIT
component.summary: Local-first AI agent hub with tools, skills, and MCP support
本地优先的 AI Agent 工具中枢，支持工具、技能与 MCP

description.p: BIT is a local-first AI agent desktop application. Chat with any OpenAI / Gemini / Claude protocol provider, let the AI run shell commands, read and write files, make plans, and grow its own toolset by writing and registering scripts as first-class tools.
BIT 是一个本地优先的 AI Agent 桌面应用：接入任意 OpenAI / Gemini / Claude 协议的模型提供方，让 AI 执行 Shell 命令、读写文件、制定计划， 还能自己编写脚本注册为常驻工具，越用越顺手。

ul.li: Built-in tool registry: shell, files, plans, memory, skills, images
MCP client & server — connect external MCP servers, or expose your tools at POST /mcp
OpenAI-compatible /v1 API with client-key + access-password auth (off by default)
Full audit log of every tool invocation

description.p: Remote access now defaults to off; headless mode for E2E testing; theme accent fixes; 8-platform native packages including ChromeOS (Crostini) via the Linux packages.
